pattern.description: The cursor clicks the orange Comment button in the toolbar, then the view jumps and settles on the Tweaks panel beside the phone prototype, where the cursor turns into a crosshair ready to place a comment.
pattern.why_premium: The camera follows the cursor's intent: a click on Comment leads straight into the comment-placing state (crosshair over the panel) with the moss-themed prototype in view, so the feature is shown working, not explained.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.cursor', {scale: 0.9, duration: 0.08, yoyo: true, repeat: 1}) for the click; then tl.fromTo('.stage', {scale: 1.6, y: 120}, {scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out'}); swap cursor sprite to crosshair with tl.set at the reframe end.
build_hint.remotion: Click: cursor scale = 1 - 0.1 * Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp(frame / 4)); stage scale = interpolate(spring({frame: frame - 6, fps, config: {damping: 28, stiffness: 160}}), [0, 1], [1.6, 1]); cursor icon chosen by frame threshold.

notes: The large change between f948 and f949 (energy peak) may be a hard cut inside the shot rather than an animated reframe; code reports only a small tilt_down. Moss is already selected and the phone already green in every frame after the cut, so no swatch change happens in this burst.
